rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a Day 5 3AA blastocyst and appropriately covers expansion, ICM, TE, and zona thinning, but it likely overstates image-specific certainty and adds minor details not clearly verifiable from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, tubal factor diagnosis, endometrium, sperm parameters, first-cycle status, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimates broadly supported by the case; minor issues include somewhat speculative quantitative adjustments and slight double-counting risk around morphology/euploidy/PGT-A.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice, including SET for a good-prognosis patient and appropriate caution on PGT-A; small deviations include speculative ERA use after only two failures and nonstandard routine estradiol/progesterone monitoring suggestions.
Provides clear, practical next steps for the current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, with specific options and appropriate nuance.
